channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Euro steadies against Japanese Yen as ECB rate hike expectations strengthen
item.description: EUR/JPY trades around 183.80 on Thursday at the time of writing, little changed on the day.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Benign inflation reinforces RBI pause – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research economist Radhika Rao analyzes India’s July inflation data and its implications for the Reserve Bank of India. She notes that benign core inflation and limited spillovers from external shocks support a continued RBI policy pause.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: Anchored expectations back RBNZ hikes – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes NZD/USD briefly dipped below its 200-day moving average as the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) Q3 inflation expectations survey showed mixed but well-anchored readings near the 2% midpoint.

item.title: Euro gains against British Pound despite stronger UK growth data
item.description: EUR/GBP edges higher on Thursday as the Euro (EUR) draws support from hawkish European Central Bank (ECB) expectations, overshadowing stronger-than-expected UK Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data that would otherwise have supported the British Pound (GBP).

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD stands tall at two-month highs above $4,380
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) posts marginal losses on Thursday, after meeting resistance at the $4,450 area, yet with price action holding just above previous highs around $ 4,380 at the time of writing.

item.title: Federal Reserve: Gradual easing path – UOB
item.description: Alvin Liew of UOB outlines expectations for the Federal Funds Rate following the July US CPI release. Market pricing for a September hike has fallen, and UOB’s base case is an extended pause through 2026.

item.title: European Central Bank: Independence risks rise with debt – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Dr. Marco Wagner assesses how political pressure threatens the European Central Bank’s (ECB) independence using a Central Bank Pressure Index based on AI analysis of politicians’ statements.

item.title: Silver slips below $65, but cooling US inflation keeps downside in check
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) trades lower around $64.90 on Thursday at the time of writing, down 0.64% on the day. The white metal consolidates after its recent advance as investors refrain from taking large positions ahead of the release of US producer inflation data.

item.title: Riksbank: Rate hike risks rise – Nomura
item.description: Nomura strategists expects the Riksbank to keep its policy rate at 1.75% in August, with no change through 2026.

item.title: Indian Rupee drops despite lower US Dollar, oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) is under pressure against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday. The USD/INR pair rises to near 95.44 after a corrective move the previous day, even as the US Dollar and oil prices trade lower.

item.title: British Pound: Solid UK data, limited BoE impact – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes GBP/USD trading directionless near 1.3500 as United Kingdom (UK) Q2 and June Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data show encouraging activity. Growth was driven by investment and consumption, with government spending a drag.

item.title: British Pound recovers early losses against US Dollar, US PPI data eyed
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) claws back its early losses against the US Dollar (USD) and flattens at around 1.3495 during the European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: Norwegian Krone: Norges Bank softens hawkish stance – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities’ Norges Bank analysis notes the policy rate was left unchanged at 4.25% in August, with a less hawkish tone than in June.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Capped below the 50% retracement of July’s plunge, at 159.50
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) remains practically flat against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Thursday, as fading hopes of a Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hike in September have undermined speculative demand for the Greenback.

item.title: Gold retreats from two-month high as traders await US PPI
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) comes under selling pressure on Thursday, erasing all the gains recorded in the previous day after hitting a fresh two-month high of $4,449 during Asian trading hours. At the time of writing, the precious metal trades around $4,386, down 0.52% on the day.

item.title: Economists agree: ECB to hike interest rates by 25 bps to 2.5% in September - Reuters
item.description: According to a Reuters poll, the European Central Bank (ECB) will hike its deposit rates by 25 basis points (bps) to 2.50% in September, said 57 of 69 economists.

item.title: Australian Dollar caught between hawkish RBA, Iran-related inflation risks
item.description: AUD/USD trades around 0.7055 on Thursday at the time of writing, little changed on the day.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Bearish bias against US Dollar within higher range – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note USD/JPY closed little changed at 159.41 after briefly dipping to 158.58 and rebounding to 159.54. Intraday, the pair is expected to trade between 158.70 and 159.70.

item.title: US Dollar: CPI-driven moves point to near-term stability – MUFG
item.description: Lee Hardman at MUFG reports that the US Dollar’s initial post-CPI weakness quickly reversed, with the dollar index returning to around 100.00 as markets trimmed but did not abandon expectations for a September Fed hike.

item.title: Brazilian Real: Election risks threaten carry story – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists note USD/BRL has formed a higher low and is testing its 200-day moving average near 5.22, with upside projections toward 5.34–5.38.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Thursday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.48 per troy ounce, down 1.30% from the $65.32 it cost on Wednesday.

item.title: Euro: Range tests with upside bias against US Dollar – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole keeps a constructive stance on EUR/USD after recent US data, based on a view that the Federal Reserve is unlikely to deliver further tightening.

item.title: US Dollar: Inflation outlook and Fed path – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Alvin Liew assesses United States (US) inflation and Federal Reserve (Fed) policy after the July Consumer Price Index (CPI) report. Liew notes headline and core CPI remain above the Fed’s 2% target but sees inflation gradually easing, with headline CPI averaging 3.5% and core 2.8% in 2026.

item.title: Swiss Franc holds ground following domestic Producer and Import Prices data
item.description: USD/CHF depreciates after three days of gains, trading around 0.8130 during the European hours on Thursday. The pair holds losses as the Swiss Franc (CHF) remains stronger following Swiss Producer and Import Prices data for July.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ hike expectations support JPY against US Dollar - MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes the Japanese Yen has strengthened modestly as markets anticipate a faster pace of Bank of Japan policy tightening.

item.title: Eurozone Industrial Production remains flat in June vs. -0.1% estimates
item.description: The Eurozone industrial sector activity remained flat in June, while it was expected to decline 0.1%, according to data published by Eurostat. In May, Industrial production contracted by 0.3%, revised lower from -0.2%.

item.title: Euro bounces off one-week low, holds above 1.1500 vs USD as traders look to US PPI
item.description: The EUR/USD pair drops to a one-and-a-half-week low during the first half of the European session, though it manages to recover a few pips from the vicinity of the 1.1500 psychological mark.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Recovery not just about Oil – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister argues Canada’s recent economic improvement is not solely driven by higher Oil and gas prices linked to the Iran conflict.

item.title: Euro advances against Canadian Dollar amid ECB hawkish stance, lower oil prices
item.description: EUR/CAD halts its six-day losing streak, trading around 1.6080 during the European hours on Thursday. The currency cross gains ground as the Euro (EUR) receives support as the macroeconomic picture in the Eurozone continues to support the European Central Bank's (ECB) hawkish stance.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Cooling NZ inflation expectations push Kiwi under pressure
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) underperforms its major currency peers, trading 0.45% down at around 0.5830 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday.
